run_robot_square_movement: run the robot square movement demo using polymetis RobotInterface and Cartesian impedance control
create_robot_interface: create a polymetis RobotInterface connection to a robot by IP address with version enforcement disabled
test_ee_pose_movement: test moving a robot end-effector to a target pose using move_to_ee_pose and get_ee_pose
build_cartesian_impedance_loop: build a Cartesian impedance control loop that updates the desired end-effector pose at a fixed control frequency
publish_transform_and_json: publish TransformStamped and JSON messages via a0 Publisher to show desired and actual end-effector positions
